speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I think music isn't that different from books in this sense — different generations face different problems.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: The older generation might have worried about earning money, about moving to a bigger city to make a living.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: The new generation faces more problems about emotions, private affairs, personal relationships.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Because life has gotten better, the country has developed, so we face different problems now.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And music is created by singers to share their experiences and express their emotions.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So different generations have different music — there are some common things, but there are differences too.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: It's because of the generation, because of the era, I think.
